A python package for analysing the performance of a Construction Project compared to {{< var UKNZCB-link >}}.

:::{.callout-caution}
Whilst the package is usable as is it is limited in scope compared to UKNZCB and still under active development.
:::

Whilst the intention is that the package will evolve to be able to report on all the metrics defined in the
UKNZCB Standard, it is currently only considering Operational Energy Targets. This requires the tracking
of the following data:

- project buildings, areas and end-types
- in-use operational energy usage
- predicted operational energy usage
  (whilst this cannot demonstrate compliance with the UKNZCB guide it is valuable to track during the design stage)
- custom targets where applicable


```{python}
from netzero_metrics.plots import plot_eui 
plot_eui()
```
